summary.plain: The design document for the two MINOS steel-and-scintillator detectors, one at Fermilab and one nearly 500 miles away in the Soudan mine in Minnesota.
summary.technical: NuMI-L-337 / FERMILAB-DESIGN-1998-02: the MINOS Technical Design Report for the magnetised steel-scintillator near and far detectors on the NuMI beamline.
